weapon.d: Grants bonus to unit’s Atk = total bonuses on unit during combat.

special.d: Before combat this unit initiates, foes in an area near target take damage equal to (unit's Atk minus foe's Def or Res).
Before combat this unit initiates, foes in an area near target take damage equal to 1.5 x (unit's Atk minus foe's Def or Res).

a.d: If unit initiates combat, grants Spd+2 during combat.
If unit initiates combat, grants Atk/Spd+2 during combat.
If unit initiates combat, grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat.

b.d: At the start of every fourth turn, restores 10 HP.
At the start of every third turn, restores 10 HP.
At start of odd-numbered turns, restores 10 HP.

c.d:
While unit lives and uses a green tome, unit gets 1.5x EXP.
(Only highest value applied. Does not stack.)

While unit lives, all green tome allies on team get 1.5x EXP.
(Only highest value applied. Does not stack.)

While unit lives, all green tome allies on team get 2x EXP.
(Only highest value applied. Does not stack.)
